units.why: "Generate practice questions to study for exams" permits study aids, P14.

units.passage: Help organize notes to improve understanding of concepts
units.policy: When appropriate for context and discipline, GenAI might be used to help organize notes to improve understanding of concepts.
units.why: "Help organize notes to improve understanding of concepts" is a study aid use, P14.

units.passage: Low-Risk Applications: AI may be used for tasks such as generating content drafts, language translations, or creating study materials, provided outputs are reviewed by a human.
units.why: AI 'may be used' for 'generating content drafts, language translations, or creating study materials, provided outputs are reviewed by a human'; permitted low-risk uses, P14 for study materials, chosen as the closest type for a mixed list.

units.passage: AI may be used for brainstorming ideas, for exam preparation, for finding initial information, for generating initial lists of ideas and/or related papers to investigate, and for some image generation.
units.policy: AI may be used for exam preparation
units.why: "for exam preparation" is a separate permitted use (study aid), P14.

units.passage: AI may be used for brainstorming ideas, for exam preparation, for finding initial information, for generating initial lists of ideas and/or related papers to investigate, and for some image generation;
units.policy: AI may be used for exam preparation
units.why: "for exam preparation" is a permitted study use, P14.

units.passage: Creating effective study schedules and routines
units.why: "Creating effective study schedules and routines" names an allowed study use of AI; nearest is P14 (study aids), with a fit note.

units.passage: Organizing group study sessions and materials
units.why: "Organizing group study sessions and materials" is a listed potential use of AI for studying, P14 (study aids).

units.passage: generating summaries or explanations of challenging material for your own reflection
units.policy: Generative AI tools may be used for generating summaries or explanations of challenging material for the student's own reflection.
units.why: 'generating summaries or explanations of challenging material for your own reflection' is listed as a permitted study-aid use; P14 names summaries, so P14 over P12, which is about tutor-like help understanding concepts.

units.passage: Summarizing academic articles
units.why: Students may have access to AI research assistants that summarize articles, generate citations and suggest sources; summaries as study aid, P14.

units.passage: Students may consult AI generative tools in limited situations. Examples: to clarify definitions of terms or differentiate between terms (e.g., methods vs. methodology, health humanities vs. medical humanities), to synthesize information about ethical principles, to summarize key points from a supplementary text not primarily assigned in your program or course, or to serve as an editor to review your writing style for grammar, spelling, and organization.
units.policy: Students may consult AI generative tools to summarize key points from a supplementary text not primarily assigned in the program or course.
units.why: The example 'to summarize key points from a supplementary text not primarily assigned' permits AI summaries of non-core reading, a study-aid use (may), P14.

units.passage: You may use generative AI for learning support and planning, such as explaining concepts, generating practice questions, brainstorming ideas, or creating a preliminary outline.
units.why: Level 1 allows 'generating practice questions', a study aid, P14.

units.passage: Have students use AI as a tutoring tool to help them prepare for tests
units.why: Idea 1 says 'Have students use AI as a tutoring tool to help them prepare for tests by checking their understanding', a study aid, P14.

units.passage: Students can use AI platforms to help prepare for assignments and projects.
units.why: "Students can use AI platforms to help prepare for assignments and projects" permits AI for preparation and study; P14 is nearest.

units.passage: Asking AI for practice questions or explanations of concepts (after attempting them yourself first), then checking your understanding against course materials
units.why: Recommended: "practice questions or explanations of concepts" after trying alone; study aids, P14 (explanations are P12 but practice questions lead).

units.passage: Creating work plans, checklists, or self-assessment criteria to monitor your learning process
units.why: Recommended: "work plans, checklists, or self-assessment criteria" to monitor learning - study aids and self-checks, P14.

units.passage: AI can serve as a tutor generating study aids such as flashcards, quizzes, and practice questions to help students test and strengthen their knowledge.
units.why: "AI can serve as a tutor generating study aids such as flashcards, quizzes, and practice questions" lists self-testing and study aids as benefits, P14, may.

units.passage: Similarly, it is usually very effective to copy in the text of a homework and give a prompt like “Here is a recent homework set. Generate a new one of the same difficulty level and similar content so we can get more practice.”
units.why: Pasting in a homework and asking for "a new one of the same difficulty level" so "we can get more practice" is generating practice problems, P14, may.

units.passage: Presentation Practice: Using AI to generate sample questions for Q&A or simulate practice sessions
units.policy: Acceptable use of AI: presentation practice, using AI to generate sample questions for Q&A or simulate practice sessions.
units.why: 'Presentation Practice: Using AI to generate sample questions for Q&A or simulate practice sessions' is acceptable; practice and study aid, P14.

units.passage: Serving as a supplemental FAQ or study aid
units.policy: Generative AI can serve as a supplemental FAQ or study aid.
units.why: Lists AI as "a supplemental FAQ or study aid": study aids, P14.

units.passage: Generating summaries, flashcards, or practice questions
units.policy: Generative AI can generate summaries, flashcards, or practice questions.
units.why: Lists AI generation of "summaries, flashcards, or practice questions": P14.

units.passage: If you are going into a situation where you will be asked or will have to ask questions, GenAI can suggest questions to expect or ask as well as offer responses to consider.
units.why: 'GenAI can suggest questions to expect or ask as well as offer responses to consider' lists interview or quiz practice. P14 fits.

units.passage: Students can also use the tools to create virtual flash cards and other study aids.
units.why: "create virtual flash cards and other study aids" is a study-aid use, P14.

units.passage: You can use a prompt like “quiz me on protein folding”, and the tool will deliver a series of questions; you can then answer those questions and the tool will give you feedback on your responses.
units.why: Describes prompting "quiz me on protein folding" and getting feedback; self-quizzing as study aid (P14).

units.passage: Allowed: using AI to explain a concept, generate practice questions, or help you study for a quiz
units.why: Example 'Allowed: using AI to explain a concept, generate practice questions, or help you study for a quiz' permits practice and study aids, P14.

units.passage: Allowed: using AI on an ungraded practice exercise or exploratory code that will not be submitted for credit.
units.why: Example: 'Allowed: using AI on an ungraded practice exercise or exploratory code that will not be submitted': practice use, P14.

units.passage: You may use AI tools for learning and practice. This means you can use AI to learn concepts, practice problem-solving, and enhance your understanding of the course material
units.why: 'you can use AI to learn concepts, practice problem-solving, and enhance your understanding' allows AI for practice and study, P14.

units.passage: To access just-in-time support at various stages of the learning process: generating or testing out ideas or formulas; summarizing or distilling complex thinking
units.why: "summarizing or distilling complex thinking" lists summarizing as a potential student use, which fits study aids and summaries (P14).

units.passage: To check knowledge of course content by generating practice quizzes
units.why: 'check knowledge of course content by generating practice quizzes' is a study aid use (P14).
